'''Mii Heswop''' claimed to be a competent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and computer [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who had traveled extensively as a crew member on many different ships. In fact, the stout man had no real skills, and little ability to learn. Rather, Heswop was an egocentric individual who was possessed of a great deal of useless trivia about a large range of topics, but virtually no in-depth knowledge.

While on [[StarForge Station]] Heswop responded to a call by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij|Dhas Vedij]] to join the crew of the [[Rebel privateer]] vessel ''[[Far Orbit]]''.
